proposed_comments.title: Separate static zoom timing from live zoom cadence

confidence.rationale: The current head removed the original 20 ms step constant, then ZoomAnimation::Duration hard-codes a 40 ms step for both static and live zoom paths.

proposed_comments.body:
### Separate static zoom timing from live zoom cadence

**Severity:** `medium`

`ZoomAnimation::Duration` currently uses one hard-coded 40 ms cadence for both static and live zoom. That doubles the static zoom duration relative to the original 20 ms telescope step, while live zoom still needs the slower cadence; keep the frame cadence, refresh cadence, and live-step cadence distinct so each caller can request the intended timing.

```suggestion
#define ZOOM_ANIMATION_FRAME_TIME	10
#define LIVEZOOM_REFRESH_FRAME_TIME	20
#define LIVEZOOM_ANIMATION_STEP_TIME	40
```

proposed_comments.title: Let callers choose the animation step duration

confidence.rationale: The shared helper is used by both static and live zoom, which have different intended cadences.

proposed_comments.body:
### Let callers choose the animation step duration

**Severity:** `medium`

The duration helper is used by both static zoom and live zoom, but those paths have different historical step cadences. Add an optional step-duration parameter so static zoom keeps the original default while live zoom can explicitly pass its slower cadence.

```suggestion
    static std::uint64_t Duration(float currentZoom, float targetZoom, bool firstStepWasImmediate, std::uint64_t stepTimeMilliseconds = 20);
```

proposed_comments.title: Preserve nonzero duration for one-step transitions

confidence.rationale: For a first-step-immediate transition such as 1.25x back to 1.0x, OriginalDuration can return 0 even though the zoom delta is still visible.

proposed_comments.title: Do not call magnifier smoothing after failed live-window creation

confidence.rationale: The smoothing call executes after the live-window creation attempt even when CreateWindowEx fails, and it passes the magnifier child handle without the null/fullscreen guard used elsewhere.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the hidden live zoom window cache bounded

confidence.rationale: The current head changes current Windows from destroying the hidden magnifier immediately to keeping its fullscreen surfaces resident without any timeout.

proposed_comments.title: Drop back to the live-refresh timer after animation completes

confidence.rationale: The timer is started at 10 ms for animation, but the current code never switches it back after the animation becomes inactive.

proposed_comments.title: Restart live animation timer after retargeting

confidence.rationale: Retargeting while the timer is in steady-state refresh mode otherwise delays animation frames by the refresh interval.

proposed_comments.body:
### Restart live animation timer after retargeting

**Severity:** `medium`

After the idle timer has been reduced to the normal live-refresh cadence, a Ctrl+Up/Ctrl+Down retarget can start a new animation without restoring the faster animation timer. Pass the live zoom cadence into the duration calculation and reset the timer according to whether the retarget actually started an animation.

```suggestion
            zoomLevel = zoomAnimation.Retarget( zoomTelescopeTarget, GetTickCount64(),
                                                ZoomAnimation::Duration( zoomLevel, zoomTelescopeTarget, false, LIVEZOOM_ANIMATION_STEP_TIME ) );
            SetTimer( hWnd, 0, zoomAnimation.IsActive() ? ZOOM_ANIMATION_FRAME_TIME : LIVEZOOM_REFRESH_FRAME_TIME, NULL );
```

proposed_comments.title: Use live cadence and timer reset for escape zoom-out

confidence.rationale: The escape path shares the same live animation state as hotkey retargeting, so it must restore animation cadence when beginning the zoom-out to 1x.

proposed_comments.body:
### Use live cadence and timer reset for escape zoom-out

**Severity:** `medium`

Escaping live zoom can start a new zoom-out while the timer is running at the steady refresh cadence. Use the live animation step duration and restore the animation timer immediately so the zoom-out remains smooth and finishes on schedule.

```suggestion
                zoomLevel = zoomAnimation.Retarget( zoomTelescopeTarget, GetTickCount64(),
                                                    ZoomAnimation::Duration( zoomLevel, zoomTelescopeTarget, false, LIVEZOOM_ANIMATION_STEP_TIME ) );
                SetTimer( hWnd, 0, zoomAnimation.IsActive() ? ZOOM_ANIMATION_FRAME_TIME : LIVEZOOM_REFRESH_FRAME_TIME, NULL );
```

proposed_comments.title: Keep the fractional viewport when entering annotation modes

confidence.rationale: The upstream code deliberately switches back to integer source coordinates while drawing, tracing, or typing, so entering annotation can shift the magnified content by up to one source pixel.

proposed_comments.title: Compile the native animation tests as C++17

confidence.rationale: The new native unit-test project does not set a language standard, while the reviewed fix adds the same explicit C++17 setting used to make the test project build consistently.

proposed_comments.body:
### Compile the native animation tests as C++17

**Severity:** `high`

The new native unit-test project does not set a C++ language standard, so it can compile under the toolset default instead of the C++17 mode used by the code under test. Set the project standard explicitly so the tests build consistently on CI and local developer machines.

```suggestion
      <PrecompiledHeader>NotUsing</PrecompiledHeader>
      <LanguageStandard>stdcpp17</LanguageStandard>
      <TreatAngleIncludeAsExternal>true</TreatAngleIncludeAsExternal>
```
